Scope: Seven PP-OCR v4/v5/v6 complete DET-to-merge pipelines on three fixed images; ONNX Runtime CPU versus OpenVINO CPU.
Boundary: Single-run functional integration evidence only. Inputs and Session creation are outside the recorded OcrPipeline.Run timing. Demo images have no transcription ground truth. Text and region-count parity do not establish accuracy. Canonical result hashes are compared only when source/model/dictionary and character-set identity/version/hash metadata match. RTX 2060 is host hardware only: both tested backends ran on CPU. Not a steady-state benchmark, GPU test, or full support claim.
